comparison.objective: Holster an EV charging plug and hang its cable clear of a parking bay; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Plug seating plus flexible-cable draping versus bimanual mandrel stabilization, controlled impact fracture, withdrawal, and millimetre-scale recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Plug and cable stowed clear of the bay and released; candidate requires four retained inserts, four contained tangs, no damage, and a stable released finish.
comparison.reason: The shared generic notions of alignment and release do not equate cable stowage with controlled metal fracture and debris recovery.
